reasoning_summary: The Dfp.multiply(int x) method was implemented with an implicit assumption that the input integer 'x' would always be within the range [0, RADIX). The fix correctly extends the method to handle arbitrary integers by creating a new Dfp instance for values outside the optimized range, ensuring compliance with the FieldElement contract.
